comment.text: Title of the empty screen of the Skill sets list in the AI Chat section for a user who may create one, when the list holds nothing. Short heading, no full stop. Terms: agent = an AI assistant set up with a model, skill sets and knowledge bases; skill set = a room of skills (Markdown instructions); knowledge base = a room of files the assistant searches. Match Common:Agents, Common:SkillSets, Common:AIProjectKnowledgeRooms.
